name: tbf-stp-drop
about: As tbf-stp-fit but the queue is 51 bytes, one byte less than a config BPDU: every BPDU S1 sends is dropped at the queue. Hello time 1.5 s; the first action skips the start-up BPDUs and the second spans exactly two hello periods, so the BPDU count does not depend on the phase of the kernel's hello timer.
